adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, imported HTML is generated via `Readability::Document.new(..., tags: %w[... a ...], attributes: %w[href src])` and then persisted via `TopicEmbed.import(...)`. The created post is explicitly marked `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, bypassing Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. There is no filtering of `href`/`src` schemes in this diff, so a `javascript:` URL in an imported `<a href>` would be stored and rendered as-is, enabling XSS/script execution from imported link hrefs.
